source: diagnosePageHealth() run under the capture harness in capture/, with the same handler input mapping, over the REAL UIBridgeRegistry.createSnapshot() of a jsdom registry holding a laid-out page (LAID_OUT in the harness: a 3-link sidebar, a heading, three content cards one of which reads 'Loading queue…', a disabled and an enabled button) in a 1280x800 viewport. jsdom has no layout engine, so each element's getBoundingClientRect and window.innerWidth/innerHeight are stubbed; visibility, normalizedRect, categories and every page-health check are SDK code.

notes: status=measured, summary=WARNING (text_signals: one loading phrase), coverage {considered: 9, measured: 9}, a heatmap with `#` cells, and per-check data.
